        fields[field["field"]] = field
    keys = [field for field in fields.values() if _member(field.get("schema"), "is_primary_key") is True]
    _require(len(keys) == 1 and keys[0]["field"] == source["primaryField"],
             "DATASET_DIRECTUS_NATIVE_KEY_CHANGED")
    values, selected = {}, set()
    for value, state in _presence_pairs(columns, "DATASET_DIRECTUS_STATE_COLUMNS_CHANGED"):
        name = value["sourceField"]
        field = fields.get(name)
        _require(field is not None and name not in selected and value["type"] == "string"
                 and value["nullable"] is False and value["encoding"] == "json",
                 "DATASET_DIRECTUS_VALUE_PROJECTION_CHANGED")
        nullable = _member(field.get("schema"), "is_nullable")
        definition = {
            "collection": source["collection"], "field": name, "sourcePath": name,
            "type": field.get("type") if field.get("type") is not None else "unknown",
            "nullable": nullable if type(nullable) is bool else None,
            "schema": field.get("schema"), "meta": field.get("meta"),
            "relations": [relation for relation in native["relations"]
                          if (relation.get("collection") == source["collection"] and relation.get("field") == name)
                          or (relation.get("related_collection") == source["collection"]
                              and _member(relation.get("meta"), "one_field") == name)],
        }
        presence = {"sourcePath": name, "role": "source-presence",
                    "sourceNullable": definition["nullable"], "values": ["value", "null", "missing"]}
        _require(same_json(value["sourceDefinition"], definition)
                 and same_json(state["sourceDefinition"], presence),
                 "DATASET_DIRECTUS_NATIVE_DEFINITION_CHANGED")
        selected.add(name)
        values[value["name"]] = value
    _paired_primary(primary, values, "DATASET_DIRECTUS_PRIMARY_KEY_CHANGED")
    _require(same_json(primary["source"], [source["primaryField"]])
             and all(values[name]["sourceField"] == source["primaryField"] for name in primary["projected"])
             and primary["complete"] == (len(primary["projected"]) == 1),
             "DATASET_DIRECTUS_PRIMARY_KEY_CHANGED")


def identity(document):
    source = document.get("source") if isinstance(document, dict) else None
    _require(isinstance(source, dict), "DATASET_SEMANTIC_SOURCE_INVALID")
    result = {"schema": document.get("schema"), "sha256": document.get("sha256"),
              "definitionSha256": document.get("definitionSha256"),
              "captureManifestSha256": source.get("captureManifestSha256")}
    _require(isinstance(result["schema"], str) and result["schema"] in SCHEMAS and all(isinstance(result[key], str) and
             _HEX.fullmatch(result[key]) for key in _IDENTITY if key != "schema"),
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    if result["schema"] == ODATA_SCHEMA:
        _require(source.get("provider") == "odata4"
                 and source.get("protocolVersion") in ("4.0", "4.01")
                 and all(isinstance(source.get(key), str) and 0 < len(source[key]) <= 8192
                         for key in ("serviceUrl", "schemaUrl", "entityContainer", "entitySet", "entityType"))
                 and isinstance(source.get("schemaSha256"), str)
                 and _HEX.fullmatch(source["schemaSha256"])
                 and isinstance(document.get("csdl"), dict),
                 "DATASET_ODATA_SOURCE_FORMAT_INVALID")
    if result["schema"] == SUPERSET_SCHEMA:
        query = document.get("query")
        _require(source.get("provider") == "apache-superset"
                 and source.get("protocolVersion") == "6.1"
                 and _canonical_base_url(source.get("baseUrl"))
                 and _safe_integer(source.get("chartId"), 1)
                 and (source.get("chartUuid") is None or _text(source.get("chartUuid")))
                 and _safe_integer(source.get("queryOrdinal"))
                 and all(_sha256(source.get(key)) for key in
                         ("queryContextSha256", "principalSha256", "schemaSha256"))
                 and isinstance(query, dict)
                 and query.get("savedContextSha256") == source["queryContextSha256"]
                 and (query.get("rowLimit") is None or _safe_integer(query.get("rowLimit")))
                 and _safe_integer(query.get("rowOffset")),
                 "DATASET_SUPERSET_SOURCE_FORMAT_INVALID")
    if result["schema"] == DIRECTUS_SCHEMA:
        query, principal, native = source.get("query"), source.get("principal"), document.get("directus")
        _require(source.get("provider") == "directus" and source.get("protocolVersion") == "12.5"
                 and all(_text(source.get(key)) for key in ("baseUrl", "collection", "primaryField"))
                 and _sha256(source.get("schemaSha256"))
                 and source.get("definitionNumericEncoding") == "original-json-number-lexemes"
                 and isinstance(query, dict) and isinstance(query.get("fields"), list)
                 and isinstance(query.get("sort"), list)
                 and isinstance(principal, dict) and _text(principal.get("id"))
                 and isinstance(native, dict) and isinstance(native.get("collection"), dict)
                 and native["collection"].get("collection") == source["collection"]
                 and isinstance(native.get("fields"), list) and isinstance(native.get("relations"), list)
                 and all(isinstance(relation, dict) for relation in native["relations"]),
                 "DATASET_DIRECTUS_SOURCE_FORMAT_INVALID")
    return result


def validate_document(document, fields):
    binding = identity(document)
    columns = document.get("columns")
    _require(isinstance(fields, list) and all(isinstance(name, str) for name in fields)
             and len(fields) == len(set(fields)), "DATASET_SEMANTIC_FIELDS_INVALID")
    _require(isinstance(columns, list) and 1 <= len(columns) <= 64,
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_COLUMNS_INVALID")
    names = []
    for column in columns:
        _require(isinstance(column, dict) and isinstance(column.get("name"), str)
                 and column["name"] and isinstance(column.get("sourceField"), str)
                 and column["sourceField"] and column.get("type") in
                 {"string", "integer", "number", "boolean"}
                 and type(column.get("nullable")) is bool
                 and column.get("encoding") in {"native", "text", "json"}
                 and isinstance(column.get("projectedDefinition"), dict)
                 and column["projectedDefinition"].get("name") == column["name"]
                 and isinstance(column.get("issues"), list),
                 "DATASET_SEMANTIC_COLUMN_INVALID")
        names.append(column["name"])
    _require(len(names) == len(set(names)) and set(fields) <= set(names),
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_SELECTED_FIELDS_CHANGED")
    primary = document.get("primaryKey")
    csvw = document.get("csvw")
    virtual = document.get("virtualColumns")
    _require(isinstance(primary, dict) and isinstance(primary.get("source"), list)
             and isinstance(primary.get("projected"), list)
             and type(primary.get("complete")) is bool
             and isinstance(document.get("aboutUrl"), dict)
             and isinstance(document.get("issues"), list)
             and isinstance(virtual, list) and isinstance(csvw, dict)
             and isinstance(csvw.get("tableSchema"), dict)
             and isinstance(csvw["tableSchema"].get("columns"), list),
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_DEFINITIONS_INVALID")
    if binding["schema"] == ODATA_SCHEMA:
        _require(len(columns) % 2 == 0, "DATASET_ODATA_STATE_COLUMNS_CHANGED")
        value_names = set()
        for index in range(0, len(columns), 2):
            value, state = columns[index:index + 2]
            _require(value.get("role") == "value" and state.get("role") == "state"
                     and state["sourceField"] == value["sourceField"]
                     and state["name"] == value["name"] + "_state"
                     and value.get("stateColumn") == state["name"]
                     and state.get("valueColumn") == value["name"]
                     and state["type"] == "string" and state["nullable"] is False
                     and isinstance(value.get("sourceDefinition"), dict)
                     and isinstance(state.get("sourceDefinition"), dict)
                     and state["sourceDefinition"].get("role") == "source-presence"
                     and state["sourceDefinition"].get("sourcePath") == value["sourceField"]
                     and same_json(state["sourceDefinition"].get("values"), ["value", "null", "missing"]),
                     "DATASET_ODATA_STATE_COLUMNS_CHANGED")
            value_names.add(value["name"])
        _require(all(isinstance(key, str) and key for key in primary["source"])
                 and len(primary["source"]) == len(set(primary["source"]))
                 and all(isinstance(key, str) and key in value_names for key in primary["projected"])
                 and len(primary["projected"]) == len(set(primary["projected"]))
                 and (not primary["complete"] or len(primary["source"]) == len(primary["projected"])),
                 "DATASET_ODATA_PRIMARY_KEY_CHANGED")
    if binding["schema"] == SUPERSET_SCHEMA:
        _superset_columns(document, columns, primary)
    if binding["schema"] == DIRECTUS_SCHEMA:
        _directus_columns(document, columns, primary)
    definitions = [column["projectedDefinition"] for column in columns]
    for column in virtual:
        _require(isinstance(column, dict) and (column.get("projectedDefinition") is None
                 or isinstance(column["projectedDefinition"], dict)),
                 "DATASET_SEMANTIC_VIRTUAL_COLUMN_INVALID")
        if column.get("projectedDefinition") is not None:
            definitions.append(column["projectedDefinition"])
    _require(same_json(definitions, csvw["tableSchema"]["columns"]),
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_CSVW_CHANGED")
    return binding


def read_delivery_semantics(delivery, *, manifest=None):
    """Return verified original bytes/document, or None for a legacy delivery."""
    if manifest is None:
        manifest = parse(delivery.file("manifest.json").read_bytes(limit=4 * 1024 * 1024))
    native = delivery.native
    _require(isinstance(manifest, dict) and
             manifest.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.buyer-delivery-manifest.v1",
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_MANIFEST_INVALID")
    descriptor = manifest.get("semantics")
    output = manifest.get("outputs", {}).get("semantics.json")
    native_output = native.get("outputs", {}).get("semantics.json")
    status = native.get("nativeStatus") or {}
    if descriptor is None:
        _require(output is None and native_output is None and native.get("semantics") is None
                 and status.get("semantics") is None, "DATASET_UNEXPECTED_SEMANTICS")
        return None
    _require(isinstance(descriptor, dict) and isinstance(output, dict)
             and isinstance(native_output, dict), "DATASET_SEMANTIC_OUTPUT_REQUIRED")
    fields = manifest.get("dataset", {}).get("projectedFields")
    _require(descriptor.get("file") == "semantics.json"
             and descriptor.get("typedRowsFile") == "dataset.jsonl"
             and descriptor.get("scope") == "PUBLISHED_DATASET"
             and same_json(descriptor.get("selectedFields"), fields),
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_SELECTION_CHANGED")
    raw = delivery.file("semantics.json").read_bytes(limit=MAX_BYTES)
    exact = {"bytes": len(raw), "sha256": digest(raw)}
    _require(same_json(output, exact) and all(native_output.get(key) == value
             for key, value in exact.items()), "DATASET_SEMANTIC_FILE_CHANGED")
    document = parse(raw)
    binding = validate_document(document, fields)
    _require(all(descriptor.get(key) == value for key, value in binding.items()),
             "DATASET_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
    _require(same_json(status.get("semantics"), binding)
             and same_json(native.get("semantics"), descriptor),
             "DATASET_NATIVE_SEMANTIC_BINDING_CHANGED")
    return {"bytes": raw, "document": document, "identity": binding,
            "file": {"name": "semantics.json", **exact}, "selected_fields": list(fields)}


def validate_page_semantics(payload, receiving):
    expected = receiving["document"] if receiving is not None else None
    _require(isinstance(payload, dict) and same_json(payload.get("semantics"), expected),
             "DATASET_NATIVE_SEMANTIC_PAGE_CHANGED")
    if receiving is None:
        return
    columns = payload.get("dataset", {}).get("columns")
    definitions = expected["columns"]
    _require(isinstance(columns, list) and len(columns) == len(definitions),
             "DATASET_NATIVE_SEMANTIC_COLUMNS_CHANGED")
    for physical, definition in zip(columns, definitions):
        _require(isinstance(physical, dict) and all(same_json(physical.get(key), definition[key])
                 for key in ("name", "type", "nullable")),
                 "DATASET_NATIVE_SEMANTIC_COLUMNS_CHANGED")

    if expected["schema"] in _PAIRED_SCHEMAS:
        selected = payload.get("fields")
        rows = payload.get("rows")
        _require(isinstance(selected, list) and isinstance(rows, list)
                 and all(isinstance(row, dict) for row in rows),
                 "DATASET_NATIVE_SEMANTIC_PAGE_CHANGED")
        states = [column["name"] for column in definitions
                  if column["role"] == "state" and column["name"] in selected]
        _require(all(row.get(name) in ("value", "null", "missing")
                     for row in rows for name in states),
                 "DATASET_ODATA_STATE_VALUE_CHANGED" if expected["schema"] == ODATA_SCHEMA
                 else "DATASET_SOURCE_STATE_VALUE_CHANGED")


def sql_descriptor(receiving, fields, mapped):
    """Bind source definitions to reviewed SQL aliases without changing meaning."""
    binding = receiving["identity"]
    aliases = dict(zip(fields, mapped))
    primary = receiving["document"]["primaryKey"]
    key = primary["projected"]
    return {"schema": SQL_SCHEMA, "scope": "IMPORTED_SOURCE",
            "primary_key": {"source": key, "columns": [aliases[name] for name in key if name in aliases],
                            "complete": bool(primary["complete"] and all(name in aliases for name in key)),
                            "enforced": False},
            "semantic_sha256": binding["sha256"],
            "definition_sha256": binding["definitionSha256"],
            "capture_manifest_sha256": binding["captureManifestSha256"],
            "file": receiving["file"],
            "columns": [{"source": field, "column": column} for field, column in zip(fields, mapped)]}


def sql_context(raw, descriptor, version_id, *, case_sensitive_targets=False):
    """Reopen original meanings under the receiving engine's identifier rules.

    SQLite and DuckDB use case-insensitive target names. PostgreSQL receives
    explicitly quoted names and therefore requests case-sensitive equality.
    """
    _require(isinstance(descriptor, dict) and descriptor.get("schema") == SQL_SCHEMA
             and isinstance(descriptor.get("file"), dict)
             and len(raw) <= MAX_BYTES
             and descriptor["file"].get("name") == "semantics.json"
             and descriptor["file"].get("bytes") == len(raw)
             and descriptor["file"].get("sha256") == digest(raw),
             "DATASET_SQL_SEMANTIC_FILE_CHANGED")
    mappings = descriptor.get("columns")
    _require(isinstance(mappings, list) and mappings
             and all(isinstance(column, dict) and isinstance(column.get("source"), str)
                     and isinstance(column.get("column"), str) for column in mappings),
             "DATASET_SQL_SEMANTIC_MAPPING_INVALID")
    fields = [column["source"] for column in mappings]
    targets = [column["column"] if case_sensitive_targets else column["column"].casefold()
               for column in mappings]
    _require(len(fields) == len(set(fields)) and len(set(targets)) == len(mappings),
             "DATASET_SQL_SEMANTIC_MAPPING_INVALID")
    document = parse(raw)
    binding = validate_document(document, fields)
    _require(descriptor.get("semantic_sha256") == binding["sha256"]
             and descriptor.get("definition_sha256") == binding["definitionSha256"]
             and descriptor.get("capture_manifest_sha256") == binding["captureManifestSha256"],
             "DATASET_SQL_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
    return {**descriptor, "version_id": version_id, "document": document}

"""Python applications use the original SF88 acquisition and SF100 delivery records."""
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
import os
import hashlib
from decimal import Decimal
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
import stat

from .errors import DeliveryError, NativeError, StateError
from .dataset_semantics import read_delivery_semantics, validate_page_semantics, same_json
from .result import FileDelivery, SessionAccountingResult
from .runtime import Runtime
from .storage import digest, parse, private_directory, read, unique_object

_MODE = "ORIGINAL_PYTHON_DATASET"
_ACQUISITION = "stellar-forge.sf88.dataset-acquisition.v1"
_DELIVERY = "stellar-forge.sf88.dataset-delivery.v1"
_PARTIAL = {"RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED", "PAGE_LIMIT_REACHED", "TOTAL_CAP_REACHED"}
_OUTPUTS = {"dataset.jsonl", "dataset.csv", "review.html", "manifest.json"}


def _path(value) -> Path:
    return Path(os.path.abspath(Path(value).expanduser()))


class DatasetError(NativeError):
    """A native failure or interruption, with any retained native result attached."""
    def __init__(self, code, *, acquisition, native=None, returncode=None):
        self.native = native
        self.report = native.get("report") if isinstance(native, dict) else None
        super().__init__(code, returncode=returncode, operation=acquisition)


class _DatasetOutput(FileDelivery):
    @contextmanager
    def open(self):
        parent = self.expected_destination.parent
        if private_directory(parent, create=False) != parent:
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED")
        # Reuse the original size/digest verification and the SAME descriptor.
        with super().open() as stream:
            info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            if info.st_nlink != 1 or not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_mode & 0o077:
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_PRIVATE_FILE_REQUIRED")
            yield stream


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetDelivery:
    """Original finalized data room. Its files are verified before consumption."""
    native: dict
    directory: Path

    @property
    def payment_status(self):
        return self.native["paymentStatus"]

    @property
    def status(self):
        return self.native["nativeStatus"]

    @classmethod
    def from_finalized_scan(cls, scan):
        """Open an existing direct SF100 delivery using its unchanged native scan.

        The producer calls the original SF100 scan(directory,
        {retainPayload:false}). This receiver binds that completed native result
        to its manifest and original files; it does not create an acquisition.
        """
        hexadecimal = lambda value: isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value)
        if (not isinstance(scan, dict) or scan.get("finalized") is not True
                or scan.get("nextCursor") is not None
                or not isinstance(scan.get("session"), dict)
                or scan["session"].get("schema") != "stellar-forge.buyer-delivery.v1"
                or type(scan.get("count")) is not int
                or not 0 <= scan["count"] <= 1_000_000
                or scan.get("total") != scan["count"]
                or not isinstance(scan.get("pages"), list)
                or not 1 <= len(scan["pages"]) <= 4096
                or not all(hexadecimal(scan.get(key)) for key in ("snapshot", "chain", "queryHash"))
                or not isinstance(scan.get("out"), str)):
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_FINALIZED_NATIVE_SCAN_REQUIRED")
        directory = private_directory(_path(scan["out"]), create=False)
        if str(directory) != scan["out"]:
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_DIRECTORY_INVALID")
        manifest_raw = read(directory / "manifest.json", 4 * 1024 * 1024)
        manifest = parse(manifest_raw)
        dataset = manifest.get("dataset") if isinstance(manifest, dict) else None
        if (not isinstance(manifest, dict)
                or manifest.get("schema") != "stellar-forge.buyer-delivery-manifest.v1"
                or not isinstance(dataset, dict)
                or dataset.get("rows") != scan["count"]
                or dataset.get("snapshot") != scan["snapshot"]
                or dataset.get("projectedFields") != scan.get("fields")
                or dataset.get("filters") != scan.get("filters")
                or dataset.get("ranges") != scan.get("ranges")
                or dataset.get("order") != (scan.get("order") or "csv-record-order")
                or dataset.get("originalQueryHash") != scan["queryHash"]
                or manifest.get("chainDigest") != scan["chain"]
                or not isinstance(manifest.get("sourcePages"), list)
                or len(manifest["sourcePages"]) != len(scan["pages"])
                or not isinstance(manifest.get("outputs"), dict)
                or set(manifest["outputs"]) != ({"dataset.jsonl", "dataset.csv", "review.html"} |
                    ({"semantics.json"} if manifest.get("semantics") is not None else set()))):
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
        session_raw = read(directory / "session.json", 4096)
        if parse(session_raw) != scan["session"]:
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_SESSION_CHANGED")
        previous, rows = None, 0
        archive_expected = {}
        for index, page in enumerate(scan["pages"]):
            if (not isinstance(page, dict) or page.get("index") != index
                    or page.get("previous") != previous
                    or type(page.get("returned")) is not int or page["returned"] < 0
                    or not hexadecimal(page.get("chain"))
                    or not hexadecimal(page.get("sourceSha256"))
                    or not hexadecimal(page.get("signature"))):
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_PAGE_INVALID")
            expected = {"index": index, "intent": page.get("intent"),
                        "sourceSha256": page["sourceSha256"], "evidenceSha256": page.get("evidenceSha256"),
                        "recordDigest": page["chain"], "rows": page["returned"],
                        "requestedCursor": page.get("requestCursor")}
            if manifest["sourcePages"][index] != expected:
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_PAGE_CHANGED")
            archive_name = f"pages/{index:05d}.json"
            archive_raw = read(directory / archive_name, 2 * 1024 * 1024 + 4096)
            archive = parse(archive_raw)
            if (not isinstance(archive, dict)
                    or any(archive.get(key) != page.get(key) for key in
                           ("schema", "index", "previous", "intent", "requestCursor",
                            "sourceSha256", "evidenceSha256", "signature", "chain"))
                    or not isinstance(archive.get("payload"), dict)
                    or archive["payload"].get("page", {}).get("returned") != page["returned"]):
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_ARCHIVE_CHANGED")
            # Original appendMany emits this exact compact record with chain
            # last. Hash its retained record bytes, preserving native numeric
            # lexemes and property order without a second serializer.
            suffix = b',"chain":"' + page["chain"].encode("ascii") + b'"}\n'
            if (not archive_raw.endswith(suffix)
                    or digest(archive_raw[:-len(suffix)] + b"}") != page["chain"]):
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_ARCHIVE_RECORD_CHANGED")
            archive_expected[archive_name] = {"bytes": len(archive_raw), "sha256": digest(archive_raw)}
            previous, rows = page["chain"], rows + page["returned"]
        if (previous != scan["chain"] or rows != scan["count"]
                or dataset.get("originalQuerySignature") != scan["pages"][0]["signature"]):
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_CHAIN_CHANGED")
        pages = private_directory(directory / "pages", create=False)
        names = sorted(path.name for path in pages.iterdir())
        if names != [str(index).zfill(5) + ".json" for index in range(len(scan["pages"]))]:
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_ARCHIVE_CHANGED")

        def capture(name, limit):
            path = directory / name
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
                before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
                if (not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_nlink != 1
                        or before.st_mode & 0o077 or before.st_size > limit):
                    raise DeliveryError("DATASET_PRIVATE_FILE_REQUIRED")
                checksum, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                while chunk := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
                    checksum.update(chunk)
                    size += len(chunk)
                    if size > limit:
                        raise DeliveryError("DATASET_OUTPUT_LIMIT")
                after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
                if (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns) != (
                        after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns):
                    raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
            return {"path": str(path), "bytes": size, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest()}

        outputs = {}
        for name in ("manifest.json", "dataset.jsonl", "dataset.csv", "review.html") + (
                ("semantics.json",) if manifest.get("semantics") is not None else ()):
            metadata = capture(name, 4 * 1024 * 1024 if name == "manifest.json" else
                               2 * 1024 * 1024 if name == "semantics.json" else 256 * 1024 * 1024)
            expected = ({"bytes": len(manifest_raw), "sha256": digest(manifest_raw)} if name == "manifest.json"
                        else manifest["outputs"][name])
            if {key: metadata[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")} != expected:
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_OUTPUT_CHANGED")
            outputs[name] = metadata
        archives = {"session.json": capture("session.json", 4096)}
        archive_expected["session.json"] = {"bytes": len(session_raw), "sha256": digest(session_raw)}
        archives.update({f"pages/{index:05d}.json": capture(f"pages/{index:05d}.json", 2 * 1024 * 1024 + 4096)
                         for index in range(len(scan["pages"]))})
        if any({key: metadata[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")} != archive_expected[name]
               for name, metadata in archives.items()):
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_ARCHIVE_CHANGED_DURING_RECEIVING")
        binding = {"schema": "stellar-forge.sf100.python-delivery-source.v1", "scan": scan,
                   "manifestSha256": digest(manifest_raw), "archives": archives}
        native = {"schema": "stellar-forge.sf100.dataset-delivery.v1", "sourceFormat": "SF100_SCAN",
                  "directory": str(directory), "originalNativeScan": scan,
                  "sourceBindingSha256": digest(json.dumps(binding, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False,
                                                           sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
                  "nativeStatus": {"complete": True, "finalized": True, "pages": len(scan["pages"]),
                                   "rows": scan["count"], "total": scan["total"], "snapshot": scan["snapshot"],
                                   "lastRecordDigest": scan["chain"],
                                   **({"semantics": scan["semantics"]} if scan.get("semantics") is not None else {})},
                  "paymentStatus": manifest["paymentStatus"], "outputs": outputs, "archives": archives,
                  **({"semantics": manifest["semantics"]} if manifest.get("semantics") is not None else {})}
        delivery = cls(native, directory)
        receiving = read_delivery_semantics(delivery, manifest=manifest)
        if not same_json(scan.get("semanticDocument"), receiving["document"] if receiving else None):
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_SCAN_SEMANTICS_CHANGED")

        def exact(raw):
            try:
                return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
                                  parse_float=Decimal,
                                  parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError()))
            except (UnicodeError, ValueError):
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_ROW_INVALID") from None

        def same(first, second):
            if type(first) is not type(second):
                return False
            if isinstance(first, dict):
                return first.keys() == second.keys() and all(same(first[key], second[key]) for key in first)
            if isinstance(first, list):
                return len(first) == len(second) and all(same(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, second))
            return first == second

        # The manifest's output digest alone cannot bind rows to the original
        # page chain. Stream the typed JSONL against those exact archived rows.
        # Decimal parsing retains numeric values without binary float rounding.
        with delivery.file("dataset.jsonl").open() as stream:
            for index in range(len(scan["pages"])):
                name = f"pages/{index:05d}.json"
                archive_raw = read(directory / name, 2 * 1024 * 1024 + 4096)
                expected = archive_expected[name]
                if len(archive_raw) != expected["bytes"] or digest(archive_raw) != expected["sha256"]:
                    raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_ARCHIVE_CHANGED_DURING_RECEIVING")
                payload = exact(archive_raw)["payload"]
                # Bind the same meaning on every original retained page, including
                # zero-row pages, before consuming its native typed rows.
                validate_page_semantics(parse(archive_raw)["payload"], receiving)
                source_rows = payload["rows"]
                for source_row in source_rows:
                    raw = stream.readline(2_097_153)
                    if (len(raw) > 2_097_152 or not raw.endswith(b"\n")
                            or not same(exact(raw), source_row)):
                        raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_JSONL_SOURCE_CHANGED")
            if stream.read(1):
                raise DeliveryError("DATASET_NATIVE_JSONL_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        return delivery

    def file_names(self):
        """Original finalized outputs and any direct SF100 session/page archives."""
        names = ("manifest.json", "dataset.jsonl", "dataset.csv", "review.html")
        if "semantics.json" in self.native.get("outputs", {}):
            names += ("semantics.json",)
        return names + tuple(sorted(self.native.get("archives", {})))

    def file(self, name) -> FileDelivery:
        archive = (self.native.get("sourceFormat") == "SF100_SCAN" and
                   (name == "session.json" or isinstance(name, str) and re.fullmatch(r"pages/[0-9]{5}\.json", name)))
        if name not in (_OUTPUTS | {"semantics.json"}) and not archive:
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_OUTPUT_NAME_INVALID")
        output = self.native["outputs"].get(name) or self.native.get("archives", {}).get(name)
        path = self.directory / name
        if not isinstance(output, dict) or output.get("path") != str(path):
            raise DeliveryError("DATASET_OUTPUT_METADATA_INVALID")
        return _DatasetOutput(
            record={"native":{"status":"DELIVERED", "file":dict(output)}, "returncode":0},
            expected_destination=path, max_bytes=256 * 1024 * 1024,
        )

    def read_semantics(self):
        """Return the verified original dictionary, or None for legacy data."""
        receiving = read_delivery_semantics(self)
        return receiving["document"] if receiving is not None else None

    def jsonl_rows(self):
        """Yield native typed row dictionaries in the acquired order."""
        with self.file("dataset.jsonl").open() as stream:
            while raw := stream.readline(2_097_153):
                if len(raw) > 2_097_152 or not raw.endswith(b"\n"):
                    raise DeliveryError("DATASET_ROW_LIMIT_OR_FORMAT_INVALID")
                row = parse(raw)
                if not isinstance(row, dict):
                    raise DeliveryError("DATASET_ROW_OBJECT_REQUIRED")
                yield row

    def csv_rows(self):
        """Yield native CSV values as strings; use JSONL to retain data types."""
        yield from self.file("dataset.csv").csv_rows()


class DatasetAcquisition:
    """Reopen one original private session; no parallel Python attempt journal."""
    def __init__(self, *, checkout, session, node="node", environment=None,
                 timeout=360, output_limit=16_777_216):
        self.directory = _path(session)
        self.runtime = Runtime(checkout, node=node, environment=environment,
                               timeout=timeout, output_limit=output_limit)
        self.last_report = None
        self.last_accounting = None

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, *, checkout, session, max_pages, max_total_atomic,
               config=None, workspace=None, max_rows=1_000_000,
               max_page_bytes=1_048_576, snapshot=None, **runtime_options):
        """Offline create from exactly one existing reviewed config or workspace."""
        if (config is None) == (workspace is None):
            raise StateError("DATASET_ONE_CONFIG_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
        if any(type(value) is not int for value in (max_pages, max_rows, max_page_bytes)):
            raise StateError("DATASET_INTEGER_REQUIRED")
        if not isinstance(max_total_atomic, str):
            raise StateError("DATASET_ATOMIC_STRING_REQUIRED")
        acquisition = cls(checkout=checkout, session=session, **runtime_options)
        options = ["--max-pages", max_pages, "--max-total-atomic", max_total_atomic,
                   "--max-rows", max_rows, "--max-page-bytes", max_page_bytes]
        options += ["--config", _path(config)] if config is not None else ["--workspace", _path(workspace)]
        if snapshot is not None:
            options += ["--snapshot", snapshot]
        acquisition._invoke("init", options)
        return acquisition

    def _invoke(self, command, options=()):
        result = self.runtime.run([command, "--session", self.directory, *options], target="dataset")
        native = result.output
        if not isinstance(native, dict) or native.get("mode") != _MODE:
            raise DatasetError(result.error or "ORIGINAL_DATASET_RESULT_INVALID",
                               acquisition=self, returncode=result.returncode)
        report = native.get("report")
        if isinstance(report, dict) and native.get("command") == command:
            if command in {"init", "status", "run", "recover"}:
                valid = report.get("schema") == _ACQUISITION and report.get("directory") == str(self.directory)
            elif command == "deliver":
                valid = report.get("schema") == _DELIVERY and report.get("sourceDirectory") == str(self.directory)
            else:
                valid = report.get("status") == "EXPORTED"
            if not valid:
                raise DatasetError("ORIGINAL_DATASET_RESULT_INVALID", acquisition=self,
                                   native=native, returncode=result.returncode)
            self.last_report = report
            if not result.error and not native.get("error") and (
                    result.returncode == 0 or result.returncode == 2 and report.get("status") in _PARTIAL):
                return report
        raise DatasetError(result.error or native.get("error") or "ORIGINAL_DATASET_OPERATION_INTERRUPTED",
                           acquisition=self, native=native, returncode=result.returncode)

    def inspect(self):
        """Offline native status. RUNNING means another process owns its lock."""
        return self._invoke("status")

    def run(self):
        """Execute remaining pages with original per-page review and reservations.

        Partial status is returned unchanged. Interruption raises DatasetError;
        use recover() on this same session before explicitly resuming it.
        """
        return self._invoke("run")

    def recover(self):
        """Offline native recovery. It never retries an attempted payment/page."""
        return self._invoke("recover")

    def _accounting(self, *, finalize=False, workspace=None, offset=0, limit=100,
                    outbox=None, merchant_route=None):
        if type(offset) is not int or offset < 0 or type(limit) is not int or not 1 <= limit <= 250:
            raise StateError("DATASET_ACCOUNTING_RANGE_INVALID")
        if (outbox is None) != (merchant_route is None):
            raise StateError("OUTBOX_AND_ORIGINAL_MERCHANT_ROUTE_REQUIRED_TOGETHER")
        command = "finalize" if finalize else "accounting"
        options = ["--offset", offset, "--limit", limit]
        if workspace is not None:
            options += ["--workspace", _path(workspace)]
        if outbox is not None:
            options += ["--outbox", _path(outbox), "--merchant-route", _path(merchant_route)]
        run = self.runtime.run([command, "--session", self.directory, *options], target="dataset")
        output = run.output
        if (not isinstance(output, dict) or output.get("mode") != _MODE
                or output.get("command") != command or not isinstance(output.get("report"), dict)):
            raise DatasetError(run.error or "ORIGINAL_DATASET_ACCOUNTING_FAILED",
                               acquisition=self, native=output, returncode=run.returncode)
        view = SessionAccountingResult.from_native(output["report"], kind="dataset", directory=self.directory,
            returncode=run.returncode, runtime_error=run.error, interrupted=run.interrupted)
        self.last_accounting = view
        return view

    def accounting(self, *, offset=0, limit=100) -> SessionAccountingResult:
        """Read the original retained per-page receipts without wallet or RPC."""
        return self._accounting(offset=offset, limit=limit)

    def finalize(self, *, workspace=None, offset=0, limit=100,
                 outbox=None, merchant_route=None) -> SessionAccountingResult:
        """Finish these original page reservations; never run a page again."""
        return self._accounting(finalize=True, workspace=workspace, offset=offset, limit=limit,
                                outbox=outbox, merchant_route=merchant_route)

    def finalize_all(self, *, workspace=None, page_size=25, outbox=None, merchant_route=None):
        """Yield progress while accounting for every existing page, including failures.

        Inspect each view's attention entries. Reopening accounting() reads any
        views saved before interruption, independently of delivered product files.
        """
        offset = 0
        while True:
            view = self.finalize(workspace=workspace, offset=offset, limit=page_size,
                                 outbox=outbox, merchant_route=merchant_route)
            yield view
            if view.interrupted or view.next_offset is None:
                return
            offset = view.next_offset

    def export_manifest(self, destination):
        return self._invoke("export", ["--out", _path(destination)])

    def deliver(self, destination) -> DatasetDelivery:
        """Create or reopen the same original offline SF100 data room."""
        path = _path(destination)
        report = self._invoke("deliver", ["--out", path])
        if (report.get("directory") != str(path) or not isinstance(report.get("outputs"), dict)
                or set(report["outputs"]) != (_OUTPUTS | ({"semantics.json"} if report.get("semantics") is not None else set()))):
            raise DatasetError("ORIGINAL_DATASET_DELIVERY_INVALID", acquisition=self,
                               native={"mode":_MODE, "report":report})
        delivery = DatasetDelivery(native=report, directory=path)
        if report.get("semantics") is not None:
            delivery.read_semantics()
        return delivery

"""Operate acquired datasets through the native private DuckDB workspace."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import webbrowser

from .duckdb_dataset import DuckDBWorkspace
from . import spatial_cli
from .errors import BuyerError
from .storage import parse, read

_MAX_TEXT = 1024 * 1024


def _json_argument(value, default):
    if value is None:
        return default
    return parse(value.encode("utf-8"))


def _text_file(path):
    return read(Path(path).expanduser(), _MAX_TEXT).decode("utf-8")


def _query_options(parser):
    source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    source.add_argument("--sql", help="Read-only SQL over imported tables and active views")
    source.add_argument("--sql-file", help="UTF-8 SQL file")
    parser.add_argument("--parameters", default="[]", help="JSON array of bound SQL parameters")


def _sql(args):
    return args.sql if args.sql is not None else _text_file(args.sql_file)


def _keys(value):
    return [part.strip() for part in value.split(",") if part.strip()] if value else []


def parser():
    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    result.add_argument("--workspace", "--database", dest="workspace", required=True,
                        help="Private DuckDB workspace directory")
    result.add_argument("--spatial-extension", help="Installed signed DuckDB spatial extension; may also use STARFORGE_DUCKDB_SPATIAL_EXTENSION")
    commands = result.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    spatial_cli.add_parser(commands)
    commands.add_parser("status", help="Read editions, active views, import reviews, saved queries and exports")

    inspect = commands.add_parser("inspect-delivery", help="Review an existing native delivery report")
    inspect.add_argument("report")

    review = commands.add_parser("review", help="Retain an import review with explicit field mapping")
    review.add_argument("report")
    mapping = review.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mapping.add_argument("--columns", help='JSON array of {source,name,type,nullable} mappings')
    mapping.add_argument("--columns-file", help="File containing the JSON mapping array")
    review.add_argument("--keys", default="", help="Comma-separated mapped SQL columns identifying a row")

    imported = commands.add_parser("import", help="Import a saved review as an immutable edition")
    imported.add_argument("review_id")

    editions = commands.add_parser("editions", help="Page through retained editions")
    editions.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=100)
    editions.add_argument("--before", type=int)
    edition = commands.add_parser("edition", help="Reopen an immutable edition")
    edition.add_argument("edition_id")
    meaning = commands.add_parser("semantics", help="Read the original retained source dictionary and reviewed SQL mapping")
    meaning.add_argument("edition_id")
    meaning_compare = commands.add_parser("compare-meanings", help="Compare source definitions and SQL mappings between editions")
    meaning_compare.add_argument("before_id")
    meaning_compare.add_argument("after_id")

    activate = commands.add_parser("activate", help="Select an edition through a revisioned SQL view")
    activate.add_argument("name")
    activate.add_argument("edition_id")
    activate.add_argument("--expected-revision", type=int, required=True,
                          help="Current view revision; use 0 to create a view")
    commands.add_parser("views", help="Read active SQL views")

    query = commands.add_parser("query", help="Preview a read-only SQL query")
    _query_options(query)
    query.add_argument("--max-rows", type=int, default=200)
    query.add_argument("--expected-views", help="JSON view bindings from an earlier query preview")

    saved = commands.add_parser("save-query", help="Retain or revise a named SQL recipe")
    saved.add_argument("name")
    _query_options(saved)
    saved.add_argument("--expected-revision", type=int, default=0,
                       help="Current saved query revision; 0 creates a new name")
    commands.add_parser("queries", help="Reopen saved SQL recipes")
    commands.add_parser("reviews", help="Reopen saved import reviews")
    commands.add_parser("exports", help="Read retained query exports")

    exported = commands.add_parser("export", help="Export a saved query as Parquet, CSV and source manifest")
    exported.add_argument("query_id")
    exported.add_argument("--destination", required=True, help="New private directory outside the workspace")
    exported.add_argument("--expected-revision", type=int, required=True)
    exported.add_argument("--expected-views", help="JSON view bindings from the selected query preview")

    compared = commands.add_parser("compare", help="Compare editions by their reviewed record keys")
    compared.add_argument("before_id")
    compared.add_argument("after_id")
    compared.add_argument("--keys", help="Comma-separated compatible reviewed SQL key columns")
    compared.add_argument("--max-rows", type=int, default=200)

    source_files = commands.add_parser("source-files", help="Recover the retained original delivery files for an edition")
    source_files.add_argument("edition_id")
    source_files.add_argument("--destination", required=True, help="Private directory outside the workspace")

    backup = commands.add_parser("handoff", help="Prepare a complete portable workspace with source files")
    backup.add_argument("--destination", required=True, help="New private directory outside the workspace")

    server = commands.add_parser("serve", help="Open the private local browser operator")
    server.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=0)
    server.add_argument("--open", action="store_true", help="Open the capability URL in the local browser")
    server.add_argument("--export-root", help="Private sibling parent for new query export directories")
    server.add_argument("--handoff-root", help="Private sibling parent for portable source handoffs")
    return result


def main(argv=None):
    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
    workspace = None
    try:
        workspace = DuckDBWorkspace(args.workspace)
        if args.command == "status":
            output = {
                "directory": str(workspace.directory),
                "editions": workspace.editions(limit=100),
                "views": workspace.views(),
                "reviews": workspace.reviews(),
                "queries": workspace.queries(),
                "exports": workspace.exports(),
            }
        elif args.command == "spatial":
            output = spatial_cli.dispatch(workspace, args)
        elif args.command == "inspect-delivery":
            output = workspace.inspect_delivery(args.report)
        elif args.command == "review":
            columns = parse(read(Path(args.columns_file).expanduser(), _MAX_TEXT)) if args.columns_file else _json_argument(args.columns, None)
            output = workspace.review_import(args.report, columns=columns, keys=_keys(args.keys))
        elif args.command == "import":
            output = workspace.import_review(args.review_id)
        elif args.command == "editions":
            output = workspace.editions(limit=args.limit, before=args.before)
        elif args.command == "edition":
            output = workspace.edition(args.edition_id)
        elif args.command == "semantics":
            output = workspace.semantics(args.edition_id)
        elif args.command == "compare-meanings":
            output = workspace.compare_semantics(args.before_id, args.after_id)
        elif args.command == "activate":
            output = workspace.activate(args.name, args.edition_id, expected_revision=args.expected_revision)
        elif args.command == "views":
            output = workspace.views()
        elif args.command == "query":
            output = workspace.query(_sql(args), parameters=_json_argument(args.parameters, []),
                max_rows=args.max_rows, expected_views=_json_argument(args.expected_views, None))
        elif args.command == "save-query":
            output = workspace.save_query(args.name, _sql(args),
                parameters=_json_argument(args.parameters, []), expected_revision=args.expected_revision)
        elif args.command == "queries":
            output = workspace.queries()
        elif args.command == "reviews":
            output = workspace.reviews()
        elif args.command == "exports":
            output = workspace.exports()
        elif args.command == "export":
            output = workspace.export_query(args.query_id, args.destination,
                expected_revision=args.expected_revision,
                expected_views=_json_argument(args.expected_views, None))
        elif args.command == "compare":
            output = workspace.compare(args.before_id, args.after_id,
                keys=_keys(args.keys) if args.keys is not None else None, max_rows=args.max_rows)
        elif args.command == "source-files":
            output = workspace.export_source(args.edition_id, args.destination)
        elif args.command == "handoff":
            output = workspace.backup(args.destination)
        elif args.command == "serve":
            from .duckdb_http import serve
            server, control, url = serve(workspace, port=args.port,
                export_root=args.export_root, handoff_root=args.handoff_root, spatial_extension=args.spatial_extension)
            print(json.dumps({"status": "LISTENING", "address": url.split("#", 1)[0],
                              "private_launch": str(control)}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
            if args.open:
                webbrowser.open(url)
            try:
                server.serve_forever()
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                pass
            finally:
                server.server_close()
            return 0
        else:
            raise ValueError("Unknown operator command")
        print(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2))
        return 0
    except BuyerError as exc:
        print(json.dumps({"error": exc.code}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "DUCKDB_OPERATOR_INPUT_OR_STORAGE_ERROR",
                          "detail": str(exc)[:500]}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:
        if workspace is not None and isinstance(exc, workspace.duckdb.Error):
            print(json.dumps({"error": "DUCKDB_QUERY_ERROR", "detail": str(exc)[:4096]}), file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        raise
    finally:
        if workspace is not None:
            workspace.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Read/export the original SF88 Inbox through the maintained Node runtime.

This view creates no queue, operation, payment journal or scheduler. A saved
Operations handoff is a private source edition; receiving is a separate review.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
import os
import re

from .errors import NativeError, StateError
from .runtime import Runtime

_MODE = "ORIGINAL_PYTHON_INBOX"
_MAX_VERIFY_BYTES = 1_073_741_824
_MAX_INTENTS = 100


def _absolute(value):
    try:
        path = os.fspath(value)
    except TypeError:
        raise StateError("BUYER_HANDOFF_ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED") from None
    if not isinstance(path, str) or "\0" in path:
        raise StateError("BUYER_HANDOFF_ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED")
    path = os.path.expanduser(path)
    if not os.path.isabs(path) or os.path.abspath(path) != path:
        raise StateError("BUYER_HANDOFF_ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED")
    return path


def _intent(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}", value):
        raise StateError("STABLE_INTENT_ID_REQUIRED")
    return value


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InboxResult:
    """Original native fields and this read/export process outcome, kept separate."""
    native: dict
    process: dict


class InboxError(NativeError):
    """An uncertain export keeps its explicit destination available for inspection."""
    def __init__(self, code, *, result=None, directory=None, destination=None):
        self.result = result
        self.inbox_directory = directory
        self.destination = destination
        super().__init__(code, returncode=result.process["returncode"] if result else None)


class Inbox:
    """Read-only view over an existing native Inbox and its original saved outcomes."""

    def __init__(self, *, checkout, directory, node="node", environment=None,
                 timeout=360, output_limit=16_777_216):
        self.directory = _absolute(directory)
        self.runtime = Runtime(checkout, node=node, environment=environment,
                               timeout=timeout, output_limit=output_limit)

    @classmethod
    def from_buyer(cls, buyer, directory):
        """Reuse the Buyer's selected original checkout, runtime and environment."""
        runtime = buyer.runtime
        return cls(checkout=runtime.checkout, directory=directory, node=runtime.node,
                   environment=runtime.environment, timeout=runtime.timeout)

    def _command(self, action, arguments, *, destination=None, cancel_event=None):
        try:
            run = self.runtime.run([action, *arguments], target="application",
                                   cancel_event=cancel_event)
        except (NativeError, StateError) as error:
            raise InboxError(error.code, directory=self.directory,
                             destination=destination) from error
        value = run.output
        result = InboxResult(
            native=value if isinstance(value, dict) else {},
            process={"returncode": run.returncode, "error": run.error,
                     "interrupted": run.interrupted},
        )
        if (run.returncode != 0 or run.error or not isinstance(value, dict)
                or value.get("mode") != _MODE or value.get("action") != action
                or value.get("noExecution") is not True):
            raise InboxError(run.error or "ORIGINAL_INBOX_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE", result=result,
                             directory=self.directory, destination=destination)
        if action != "inbox-inspect-operations" and value.get("root") != self.directory:
            raise InboxError("ORIGINAL_INBOX_ROOT_MISMATCH", result=result,
                             directory=self.directory, destination=destination)
        if destination is not None and value.get("path") != destination:
            raise InboxError("ORIGINAL_HANDOFF_DESTINATION_MISMATCH", result=result,
                             directory=self.directory, destination=destination)
        return result

    def list(self, *, cancel_event=None):
        """Read every existing job; original unattempted/failed/unknown states remain."""
        return self._command("inbox-list", ["--inbox", self.directory], cancel_event=cancel_event)

    def show(self, intent_id, *, cancel_event=None):
        """Read one exact original intent without invoking evidence recovery."""
        selected = _intent(intent_id)
        result = self._command("inbox-show", ["--inbox", self.directory, "--intent", selected],
                               cancel_event=cancel_event)
        if result.native.get("job", {}).get("operation", {}).get("intentId") != selected:
            raise InboxError("ORIGINAL_INBOX_INTENT_MISMATCH", result=result,
                             directory=self.directory)
        return result

    def export_operations(self, destination, *, intent_ids, max_verify_bytes=268_435_456,
                          cancel_event=None):
        """Verify selected retained output and create one private source handoff.

        A pre-existing destination is preserved. Use inspect_operations on that
        same file after an interrupted/lost return instead of recapturing state.
        """
        destination = _absolute(destination)
        if not isinstance(intent_ids, (list, tuple)) or not 1 <= len(intent_ids) <= _MAX_INTENTS:
            raise StateError("BUYER_SELECT_ORIGINAL_INTENTS")
        selected = [_intent(value) for value in intent_ids]
        if len(set(selected)) != len(selected):
            raise StateError("BUYER_SELECT_ORIGINAL_INTENTS")
        if type(max_verify_bytes) is not int or not 0 <= max_verify_bytes <= _MAX_VERIFY_BYTES:
            raise StateError("BUYER_OUTPUT_LIMIT_INVALID")
        result = self._command("inbox-export-operations", [
            "--inbox", self.directory, "--intents-json", json.dumps(selected, separators=(",", ":")),
            "--out", destination, "--max-verify-bytes", str(max_verify_bytes),
        ], destination=destination, cancel_event=cancel_event)
        if result.native.get("intentIds") != selected:
            raise InboxError("ORIGINAL_HANDOFF_SELECTION_MISMATCH", result=result,
                             directory=self.directory, destination=destination)
        return result

    def inspect_operations(self, file, *, cancel_event=None):
        """Reopen the exact saved edition, even when its original Inbox is offline."""
        file = _absolute(file)
        return self._command("inbox-inspect-operations", ["--file", file],
                             destination=file, cancel_event=cancel_event)

"""Operate complete original SF100 deliveries in a customer PostgreSQL warehouse."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from .datasets import DatasetAcquisition, DatasetDelivery
from .errors import BuyerError
from .postgres_delivery import DatasetMapping, PostgresWarehouse, WarehouseError, load_delivery_report, review_delivery
from .storage import digest, parse, private_directory, read, write


def _encode(value):
    # Decimal is emitted as exact text in the command JSON, matching the mapping.
    # It is never converted to a binary float for presentation.
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, (datetime, date)):
        return value.isoformat()
    raise TypeError(type(value).__name__)


def _delivery(args):
    if args.report:
        if args.checkout or args.delivery:
            raise WarehouseError("DATASET_PG_ONE_DELIVERY_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
        return load_delivery_report(args.report)
    if not args.checkout or not args.delivery:
        raise WarehouseError("DATASET_PG_CHECKOUT_AND_DELIVERY_REQUIRED_FOR_SESSION")
    return DatasetAcquisition(checkout=args.checkout, session=args.session, node=args.node).deliver(args.delivery)


def _save(destination, data):
    path = Path(os.path.abspath(Path(destination).expanduser()))
    if private_directory(path.parent, create=False) != path.parent:
        raise WarehouseError("DATASET_PG_PRIVATE_OUTPUT_PARENT_REQUIRED")
    write(path, data, exclusive=True)
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": len(data), "sha256": digest(data)}


def _parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--connection-env", default="SF_BUYER_POSTGRES_DSN",
                        help="existing environment variable containing libpq connection settings")
    parser.add_argument("--schema", default="sf_received", help="dedicated receiving schema")
    parser.add_argument("--expect-warehouse", help="previously observed warehouse_id")
    parser.add_argument("--statement-timeout-ms", type=int, default=300000)
    parser.add_argument("--lock-timeout-ms", type=int, default=30000)
    parser.add_argument("--out", help="save command JSON as a new private file")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("init", help="create an empty dedicated receiving schema or reopen its original identity")
    commands.add_parser("status", help="read retained editions, views and PostgreSQL version")
    browser = commands.add_parser("serve", help="create/reopen the dedicated receiving schema and local operator workspace")
    browser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, help="private review and operation directory")
    browser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=0)
    browser.add_argument("--open", action="store_true", help="open the private local browser URL")

    for name in ("review", "import"):
        command = commands.add_parser(name, help="review complete verified rows offline" if name == "review" else "commit complete original rows as one retained edition")
        source = command.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
        source.add_argument("--report", help="original native dataset-delivery JSON report")
        source.add_argument("--session", help="original complete SF88 acquisition directory")
        command.add_argument("--checkout", help="original runtime checkout, with --session")
        command.add_argument("--delivery", help="original SF100 data-room directory, with --session")
        command.add_argument("--node", default="node")
        command.add_argument("--mapping", required=True)
        if name == "import":
            command.add_argument("--expect-version", help="version_id from this original delivery and reviewed mapping")
    versions = commands.add_parser("versions", help="page retained immutable editions")
    versions.add_argument("--before", type=int)

def main(argv=None):
    args = _parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "serve":
            if args.out:
                raise WarehouseError("DATASET_PG_SERVE_SINGLE_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE")
            from .postgres_http import serve
            directory = private_directory(Path(args.workspace))
            identity_path = directory / "postgres-workspace.json"
            expected = args.expect_warehouse
            if identity_path.exists():
                identity = parse(read(identity_path, 65536))
                if (identity.get("schema") != "stellar-forge.postgres-operator.v1"
                        or identity.get("warehouse_schema") != args.schema
                        or expected is not None and expected != identity.get("warehouse_id")):
                    raise WarehouseError("DATASET_PG_OPERATOR_WAREHOUSE_CHANGED")
                expected = identity["warehouse_id"]
            warehouse = PostgresWarehouse.from_environment(
                args.connection_env, schema=args.schema, create=True, expected_warehouse=expected,
                statement_timeout_ms=args.statement_timeout_ms, lock_timeout_ms=args.lock_timeout_ms)
            server, control, url = serve(warehouse, directory, port=args.port)
            try:
                print(json.dumps({"status": "LISTENING", "address": url.split("#")[0],
                                  "private_launch": str(control),
                                  "warehouse_id": warehouse.warehouse_id}), flush=True)
                if args.open:
                    import webbrowser
                    webbrowser.open(url)
                server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.2)
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                pass
            finally:
                server.server_close()
            return 0
        if args.command in {"review", "import"}:
            mapping = DatasetMapping.from_record(parse(read(Path(args.mapping), 1024 * 1024)))
            delivery = _delivery(args)
        if args.command == "review":
            output = review_delivery(delivery, mapping)
        else:
            warehouse = PostgresWarehouse.from_environment(
                args.connection_env, schema=args.schema, create=args.command == "init",
                expected_warehouse=args.expect_warehouse,
                statement_timeout_ms=args.statement_timeout_ms, lock_timeout_ms=args.lock_timeout_ms)
            if args.command in {"init", "status"}:
                output = warehouse.status()
            elif args.command == "import":
                output = warehouse.import_delivery(delivery, mapping, expected_version=args.expect_version)
            elif args.command == "versions":
                output = warehouse.versions(before=args.before, limit=args.limit)
            elif args.command == "version":
                output = warehouse.version(args.version_id)
            elif args.command == "current":
                output = warehouse.current(args.name)
            elif args.command == "activate":
                output = warehouse.activate(args.name, args.version_id, expected_revision=args.expected_revision)
            elif args.command == "history":
                output = warehouse.history(args.name, before=args.before, limit=args.limit)
            elif args.command == "rows":
                output = warehouse.rows(args.version_id, after=args.after, limit=args.limit, include_original=args.include_original)
            elif args.command == "compare":
                output = warehouse.compare(args.previous, args.current, offset=args.offset, limit=args.limit)
            elif args.command == "semantics":
                output = warehouse.semantics(args.version_id)
            elif args.command == "compare-semantics":
                output = warehouse.compare_semantics(args.previous, args.current)
            elif args.command == "semantics-file":
                raw = warehouse.semantics_bytes(args.version_id)
                if raw is None:
                    raise WarehouseError("DATASET_PG_LEGACY_EDITION_HAS_NO_DICTIONARY")
                output = {"status": "DICTIONARY_SAVED", "version_id": args.version_id,
                          **_save(args.destination, raw)}
            else:
                saved = _save(args.destination, warehouse.manifest_bytes(args.version_id))
                output = {"status": "MANIFEST_SAVED", "version_id": args.version_id, **saved}
        encoded = (json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2, default=_encode) + "\n").encode()
        if args.out:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "SAVED", **_save(args.out, encoded)}))
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(encoded.decode())
        return 0
    except WarehouseError as error:
        print(json.dumps(error.report()), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except BuyerError as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error": error.code}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except FileExistsError:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "DATASET_PG_OUTPUT_ALREADY_EXISTS"}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except OSError:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "DATASET_PG_LOCAL_FILE_OPERATION_FAILED"}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "DATASET_PG_OPERATION_INTERRUPTED", "recovery": "reopen the same warehouse and original version_id"}), file=sys.stderr)
        return 130


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Local request authoring through the original SF88 multipart implementation."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

from .errors import StateError
from .storage import digest, dump, read

# This is the original SF31 replayable-body ceiling. The selected native runtime
# validates the body, merchant schema, media type and its exact byte pins.
MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UploadFile:
    field: str
    path: str | os.PathLike
    filename: str | None = None
    content_type: str | None = None

    def selection(self):
        value = {"field": self.field,
                 "path": os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(os.fspath(self.path)))}
        if self.filename is not None:
            value["filename"] = self.filename
        if self.content_type is not None:
            value["contentType"] = self.content_type
        return value


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MultipartRequest:
    """Fields and files are encoded by SF30 once, before native review."""
    fields: dict | None = None
    files: tuple[UploadFile, ...] = ()

    def selection(self):
        return {"fields": dict(self.fields or {}), "files": [file.selection() for file in self.files]}


def multipart_body(operation, value, headers=None):
    """Return native encoded bytes and headers. Caller holds the operation lock."""
    selection = value.selection() if isinstance(value, MultipartRequest) else value
    if not isinstance(selection, dict):
        raise StateError("MULTIPART_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".multipart-", dir=operation.directory) as temporary:
        directory = Path(temporary)
        request = directory / "selection.json"
        destination = directory / "request.body"
        dump(request, selection, exclusive=True)
        native = operation.buyer.runtime.checked(["multipart", "--input", request,
            "--out", destination], mode="ORIGINAL_PYTHON_MULTIPART_PREPARED", target="consumer")
        body = read(destination, MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES)
        if (native.get("bodyFile") != str(destination)
                or native.get("bodyBytes") != len(body)
                or native.get("bodySha256") != digest(body)
                or not isinstance(native.get("headers"), dict)):
            raise StateError("ORIGINAL_MULTIPART_RESULT_INVALID")
        # The original encoder owns the boundary. Other request headers survive.
        selected = {key: value for key, value in dict(headers or {}).items()
                    if key.lower() != "content-type"}
        selected.update(native["headers"])
        return body, selected

_COLUMNS = ("position", "phase", "revision", "kind", "notice_id", "notice_doi", "target_doi",
            "question_id", "record_id", "title", "text_json", "text_characters",
            "text_preview_json", "text_preview_complete", "citation_ids_json", "record_json")
_WORKBOOK_COLUMNS = tuple(name for name in _COLUMNS if name not in {"text_json", "record_json", "citation_ids_json"})
_SOURCE = "citation_review"
_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.citation-analysis-receiving.v1"


def _rows(selection):
    position = 0
    for phase in ("before", "reviewed", "current"):
        selected = selection["snapshots"][phase]
        notice = selected["detail"]["detail"]
        records = [("notice", {key: notice.get(key) for key in
            ("noticeId", "noticeDoi", "targetDoi", "title", "status", "fingerprint", "registeredUpdates")})]
        records.extend(("evidence", row) for row in notice["evidence"])
        records.extend(("finding", row) for row in notice["findings"])
        records.extend(("source", row) for row in notice["noticeSources"])
        records.extend(("review", {key: row.get(key) for key in
            ("id", "requestId", "requestSha256", "actor", "decision", "reason", "originalRevision", "revision", "sha256")})
                       for row in notice["reviews"])
        records.append(("coverage", {"coverage": selected["detail"]["coverage"]}))
        for kind, record in records:
            position += 1
            _need(position <= 1_000_000, "CITATION_ANALYSIS_ROW_LIMIT")
            text = record.get("text", record.get("note", record.get("reason", record.get("title", "")))) or ""
            row = {"position": position, "phase": phase, "revision": selected["revision"],
                "kind": kind, "notice_id": notice["noticeId"], "notice_doi": notice["noticeDoi"],
                "target_doi": notice["targetDoi"], "question_id": record.get("questionId", ""),
                "record_id": record.get("id", record.get("occurrenceId", record.get("noticeId", ""))),
                "title": record.get("title", ""), "text_json": json.dumps(text, ensure_ascii=True),
                "text_characters": len(text), "text_preview_json": json.dumps(text[:2000], ensure_ascii=True),
                "text_preview_complete": str(len(text) <= 2000).lower(),
                "citation_ids_json": _json(record.get("occurrenceIds", [])).decode(),
                "record_json": _json(record).decode()}
            yield row


def _content(root, raw, extension, content_type):
    sha = digest(raw)
    path = root / "files" / (sha + "." + extension)
    if _exists(path):
        actual = _pin(path)
        _need(actual["sha256"] == sha and actual["bytes"] == len(raw), "CITATION_ANALYSIS_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    else:
        write(path, raw, exclusive=True)
    return {"path": "files/" + path.name, "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha, "contentType": content_type}


def citation_analysis_source(delivery, directory):
    """Retain exact complete Research bytes beside an explicitly scoped audit index."""
    manifest = delivery.verify()
    root = private_directory(Path(directory))
    private_directory(root / "files")
    with lock(root):
        fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".citation-rows-", dir=root)
        row_count = 0
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=_COLUMNS)
                writer.writeheader()
                for row in _rows(delivery.selection):
                    writer.writerow(row)
                    row_count += 1
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            pin = _pin(temporary)
            destination = root / "files" / (pin["sha256"] + ".csv")
            if _exists(destination):
                _need(_pin(destination)["sha256"] == pin["sha256"], "CITATION_ANALYSIS_SOURCE_CHANGED")
            else:
                os.link(temporary, destination)
                sync_directory(destination.parent)
        finally:
            Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        document = {"path": "files/" + destination.name, "bytes": pin["bytes"], "sha256": pin["sha256"],
                    "contentType": "text/csv; charset=utf-8"}
        originals = []
        for role, file in (("citation-selection", delivery.selection_file),
                           ("citation-delivery-index", delivery.directory / "delivery.json")):
            with _file_delivery(_pin(file)).open() as stream:
                raw = stream.read()
            _need(len(raw) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024, "CITATION_ANALYSIS_ORIGINAL_LIMIT")
            originals.append({**_content(root, raw, "json", "application/json"), "role": role})
        archive = next(item for item in manifest["files"] if item["label"] == "current" and item["format"] == "json.gz")
        archive_parts, offset = [], 0
        with _file_delivery({**archive, "file": str(delivery.files / archive["name"])}).open() as stream:
            while raw := stream.read(16 * 1024 * 1024):
                role = "original-portable-" + str(len(archive_parts)).zfill(4)
                part = {**_content(root, raw, "bin", "application/octet-stream"), "role": role}
                originals.append(part)
                archive_parts.append({**part, "offset": offset})
                offset += len(raw)
        _need(offset == archive["bytes"], "CITATION_ANALYSIS_ORIGINAL_CHANGED")
        source_receipt = {"schema": _SCHEMA, "selectionSha256": delivery.selection_pin["sha256"],
            "rows": row_count, "columns": list(_COLUMNS), "workbookColumns": list(_WORKBOOK_COLUMNS),
            "originalPortable": {**{key: archive[key] for key in ("name", "bytes", "sha256")}, "parts": archive_parts},
            "scope": "All notice, evidence, finding, source, review-index and coverage rows for the selected notice at each of three pinned revisions."}
        originals.append({**_content(root, _json(source_receipt) + b"\n", "json", "application/json"),
                          "role": "citation-analysis-receipt"})
        value = {"schema": "stellar-forge.analysis-source-document.v1",
            "title": "Citation review — before, reviewed and current", "format": "csv",
            "document": document, "originals": originals, "complete": True,
            "provenance": {"kind": "operator-file", "publisher": "Stellar Forge Research",
                "capturedAt": delivery.selection["review"]["createdAt"],
                "scope": "Dossier " + delivery.selection["dossierId"] + "; review " + delivery.selection["review"]["id"],
                "description": "The audit index preserves complete per-evidence/finding/source records and explicit provider coverage. "
                    "Review index rows point to the entire immutable requests and decisions in the exact selection original. "
                    "The complete current Research portable archive, including all previous revisions and original source bytes, "
                    "is retained in ordered hash-checked parts. Workbook text previews are separately labelled."}}
        validate_manifest(value)
        _immutable(root / "source.json", value)
        _immutable(root / "analysis-source.json", source_receipt)
    mapping = {"collection": "", "sse_data": "text", "columns": [
        {"name": name, "pointer": "/" + name,
         "type": "integer" if name in {"position", "revision", "text_characters"} else "text",
         "missing": "error"} for name in _COLUMNS]}
    return {"manifest": str(root / "source.json"), "documentId": _pin(root / "source.json")["sha256"],
            "rows": row_count, "mapping": mapping, "columns": list(_COLUMNS)}


def _download(context, path):
    private_directory(path.parent)
    with context as (stream, record):
        if _exists(path):
            actual = _pin(path)
            _need(all(actual[key] == record[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")), "CITATION_ANALYSIS_EXPORT_CHANGED")
            return {**record, "file": str(path)}
        fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".citation-download-", dir=path.parent)
        try:
            sha, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output:
                while block := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
                    count += len(block)
                    _need(count <= record["bytes"], "CITATION_ANALYSIS_EXPORT_CHANGED")
                    sha.update(block)
                    output.write(block)
                _need(count == record["bytes"] and sha.hexdigest() == record["sha256"], "CITATION_ANALYSIS_EXPORT_CHANGED")
                output.flush()
                os.fsync(output.fileno())
            os.link(temporary, path)
            sync_directory(path.parent)
        finally:
            Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return {**record, "file": str(path)}


def run_citation_analysis(delivery, directory, *, checkout, node="node", wait_seconds=900):
    """One original response import, saved SQL, full exports, workbook and cold restore."""
    root = private_directory(Path(directory))
